integrity: All displayed all-parameter claims rest on a stated invariant-subspace proof. Exact finite computations are presented solely as corroboration. No independent audit, validation, or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary unweighted graph Laplacian only, integers p>=2 and q>=3. Universal published line-graph tree formulas already imply the tree count abstractly; the separate contribution is the closed specialization together with the full Laplacian and Fiedler-mode transition. Finite checker comparisons do not prove the parameter-uniform theorem. A potentially equivalent specialized graph-spectrum evaluation cannot be completely excluded from the literature.
title: Laplacian factorization and an eigenspace transition for rank-two parallel-class matroid polytopes
